caption: One login to the IdP uses a password plus a 6-digit TOTP; that single session then produces three signed assertions, one per SaaS app. Notice the apps never receive the password or OTP.

spec.aria: A sequence diagram where the user sends a password to the IdP, the IdP sends an OTP challenge, the user returns a 6-digit OTP, and the IdP then sends one signed assertion to SaaS A, one to SaaS B and one to SaaS C.
